scope: A research interchange contract, not the product output-format decision or Lightroom acceptance.

sources.role: Official DNG specification and SDK distribution page
Establish matrix direction and the Nikon highlight-limit fallback

container.format: Classic little-endian TIFF; main raw image in IFD0; no preview
container.ExtraSamples: Absent. Tifffile requires extrasamples=False for LinearRaw; its default emits two unspecified extra channels rejected by Adobe SDK.
container.CFA_tags: Absent. Samples are camera-native linear RGB, not a Bayer array or rendered RGB.
container.geometry: NEFX is already cropped. ActiveArea=[0,0,height,width], DefaultCropOrigin=[0,0], DefaultCropSize=[width,height], DefaultScale=[1,1].
container.orientation: Preserve source TIFF Orientation without rotating the stored pixels. Observed source value 8 is preserved as LibRaw flip=5.
container.camera_identity: Preserve Make=NIKON CORPORATION and Model=NIKON Z 8; use UniqueCameraModel=NIKON Z 8 provisionally. Adobe profile matching is unverified.

radiometry.stored_samples: Copy decoded uint16 RGB samples exactly; do not subtract black, apply white balance, color-convert or tone-map them.
radiometry.black_scope: Observed on the inherited source metadata, not a universal Z8 constant. Probe reads decoded values and requires equal levels in all four source channels.
radiometry.white_scope: Observed decoded 14-bit code limit. Sensor saturation calibration is unverified.
radiometry.camera_white_level_warning: rawpy camera_white_level_per_channel=15311 is LibRaw's Nikon fallback trunc(maximum/1.07), not a measured or file-supplied saturation tag for these inputs.
radiometry.sdk_stage3: For this LinearRaw file, stage3 equals stage2 exactly. No Bayer interpolation occurs.

color.neutral_rule: For the observed equal channel ranges, divide green gain by each RGB camera gain. Gains are not applied to stored samples.
color.matrix_direction: XYZ to camera, despite rawpy's rgb_xyz_matrix property name. LibRaw copies this table into cam_xyz, multiplies by XYZ_from_sRGB, row-normalizes, then inverts for rendering.
color.matrix_provenance: LibRaw's built-in Z8 table; not Nikon Picture Control, Adobe Camera Matching, or an independently measured camera characterization.
color.calibration_scope: Single matrix with unknown illuminant, permitted by the DNG specification. No second calibration or forward matrix is invented.
color.defaults: No camera-profile look tables, tone curve, BaselineExposure adjustment, Nikon private tags or Adobe XMP defaults are copied. Their compatibility remains unresolved.

validator.build_scope: Native Linux build of unmodified SDK source with external CMake and libjxl 0.11 compatibility overloads. XMP core and JXL enabled; XMPFiles and DocOps disabled. This is not an Adobe-distributed Linux binary.
validator.acceptance: Exit zero, Validation complete, no SDK error/warning markers, and exact stage1/stage2/stage3 comparisons. Exit status alone is insufficient.

verification.final_runner_changes: Require Python3.12 for tifffile, external destinations, equal channel ranges and NEFX input; preserve timeout diagnostics. Numerical writer and comparator unchanged.
failure_controls: Bayer NEF is rejected before writing output
Initial ExtraSamples pilot is rejected by Adobe SDK
verification.command_template: uv run --no-project tools/probe_linear_dng.py SOURCE --output OUTPUT --report REPORT --stages NEW_DIRECTORY --validator DNG_VALIDATE

cases.kind: full-size repeated-source output, not an authentic pixel-shift capture
